hazards.text: Two vendor aliases share numbers: Creative and Ectiva share 0x1102, PMC Sierra and Microsemi share 0x11f8; matching must treat the number as primary.
Identifier suffixes do not always equal values, notably O2 6730 is 0x673a and 6812 is 0x6872 plus VIA mismatches; drivers must use the numeric value.

invariants.text: The fragments form a flat vendor to device identifier registry with no executable logic, locking, state or layout beyond numeric codes grouped by vendor.
Every vendor, device, subvendor and subdevice assignment fits in sixteen bit unsigned values written as four digit hexadecimal.
Vendor values group the device and subdevice values that follow them; aliasing is intentional where two vendor names share one number.

structs.text: QLOGIC 0x1077 fixes twenty ISP codes 0x1016-0x5432; CYRIX 0x1078 fixes 0x0000-0x0104; CONTAQ 0x1080 fixes 0xc693; OLICOM 0x108d fixes 0x0012-0x0014; SUN 0x108e fixes 0x1000-0xabba; Yamaha 744 0x0010 and 754 0x0012 have vendor outside.

NI 0x1093 fixes PCI and PXI serial 0xd130-0x70ee; CMD 0x1095 fixes 0x0643-0x0649; SII 680 0x0680, 3112 0x3112, 1210SA 0x0240 with vendor outside; BROOKTREE 0x109e fixes 0x0878-0x0879; SGI 0x10a9 fixes 0x0003 and 0x1002; WINBOND 0x10ad fixes 0x0105 and 0x0565; MADGE 0x10b6 fixes 0x0002.

PLX 0x10b5 fixes bridge and serial 0x1030-0xa001; 3COM 0x10b7 fixes 0x0001-0x990a; AL 0x10b9 fixes 0x1489-0x7101; NEOMAGIC 0x10c8 fixes audio 0x8005-0x8016; TCONRAD 0x10da fixes 0x0508; ROHM 0x10db has no device here; NVIDIA vendor is 0x10de.
NVIDIA 0x10de fixes TNT 0x0020-0x00a0, GeForce and Quadro 0x0040-0x034e, FX 0x0301-0x034e and MCP and NFORCE IDE, SATA, SMBUS, audio, bridge and network 0x0034-0x0D85.

IMS 0x10e0 fixes 0x9128-0x9135; AMCC 0x10e8; AMPERE 0x1def; INTERG 0x10ea fixes 0x1682-0x5050; REALTEK 0x10ec fixes 0x8139; XILINX 0x10ee fixes 0x3fc0-0x3fc6; INIT 0x1101; CREATIVE and ECTIVA 0x1102 fix EMU, 20K and subdevices; TTI 0x1103 fixes HPT 0x0003-0x0009; SIGMA 0x1105; VIA 0x1106 fixes bridges 0x0198-0x3050.

VIA continuation fixes 0x3051-0xFFFF; SIEMENS 0x110a, VORTEX 0x1119, EF 0x111a, IDT 0x111d, FORE 0x1127, PHILIPS 0x1131, EICON 0x1133, CISCO 0x1137, ZIATECH 0x1138, SYSKONNECT 0x1148, DIGI 0x114f, XIRCOM 0x115d, SERVERWORKS 0x1166, ALTERA 0x1172, SBE 0x1176, TOSHIBA 0x1179 and 0x102f, ATTO 0x117c, RICOH 0x1180, DLINK 0x1186, ARTOP 0x1191, ZEITNET 0x1193, FUJITSU 0x119e, KEYSPAN 0x11a9, MARVELL 0x11ab and 0x1b4b, V3 0x11b0, ATT 0x11c1, SPECIALIX 0x11cb, AD 0x11d4, ZORAN 0x11de, COMPEX 0x11f6, PMC and MICROSEMI 0x11f8, RP 0x11fe, CYCLADES 0x120e, O2 0x1217, 3DFX 0x121a, AVM 0x1244 and STALLION 0x124d fix RAID, ATM, media, ISDN, bridge and graphics families.

Vendors AT 0x1259, ASIX 0x125b, ESS 0x125d, SATSAGEM 0x1267, ENSONIQ 0x1274, TRANSMETA 0x1279, ROCKWELL 0x127a, ITE 0x1283, ALTEON 0x12ae, NVIDIA_SGS 0x12d2, PERICOM 0x12d8, AUREAL 0x12eb, EDGMBH 0x12f8, ESDGMBH 0x12fe, CB 0x1307, SIIG 0x131f, RADISYS 0x1331, MICRO_MEMORY 0x1332, DOMEX 0x134a, INTASHIELD 0x135a and QUATECH 0x135c; subvendors CONNECT_TECH 0x12c4, CHASE_PCIFAST 0x12e0, CHASE_PCIRAS 0x124d and SIIG 0x131f.

Vendors SEALEVEL 0x135e, HYPERCOPE 0x1365, DIGIGRAM 0x1369, KAWASAKI 0x136b, CNET 0x1371, LMC 0x1376, NETGEAR 0x1385, APPLICOM 0x1389, MOXA 0x1393, CCD 0x1397, EXAR 0x13a8, MICROGATE 0x13c0, 3WARE 0x13c1, IOMEGA 0x13ca, ABOCOM 0x13d1, SUNDANCE 0x13f0, CMEDIA 0x13f6, ADVANTECH 0x13fe, MEILHAUS 0x1402 and LAVA 0x1407 fix serial, audio, storage and bridge families.

Device and subdevice numbers for these vendors group serial, parallel, audio, network and bridge parts, for example ESS Maestro, ITE 8211, RIVA128, PERICOM bridges, AUREAL Vortex, SIIG, QUATECH, SEALEVEL, MOXA, EXAR and LAVA serial plus CCD families.
